packages.title: Cancel while understanding said-again words brings the result back
brief: Context: P60 (b3 round 2) was verified: UX-456, UX-457 and UX-458 are fixed. Keep all of it as it is: `_sayAgain` keeping `_previousResult` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:938-957), `_review` dropping the previous capture only when a different session is understood (:916-925) and `_dropPrevious` (:927-934), `_backToResult`'s listening path (:1035-1062), CaptureResult's `_exits` row (`Cancelar` · `Volver a decirlo`, the 12 dp gap, stacking at large text), and the date line's `Semantics` label `Fecha y hora: …`. These are two regressions of P60, first attempt.

UX-461 (S2; R2A-2, verified in code, not tested). After `Volver a decirlo`, new words and `Listo`, the sheet shows `Entendiendo…`. Cancelar, Back or a swipe at that moment reaches `_cancel` (:982), whose processing branch (:984-987) pops the sheet before the `_previousResult` check (:988-992). The sheet closes, the previous result stays pending, and `_process` (:882-913) finishes in the background and keeps the new capture too: two near-duplicates in Pendientes. In the listening phase just before, the same Cancelar brings the result back.

Watch out for this when fixing it: when `Listo` is tapped while listening, `_process` runs inside `_stopRecording` (:842-846), so the `_stopping` future (`_finishRecording`, :770-778) covers the whole understanding step. If `_backToResult` awaited `_finishRecording` during `Entendiendo…`, it would wait for the new result, `_review` would drop the previous capture, and Cancel would show the new result. So the processing phase needs its own path:

1. In `_cancel`, move the `_previousResult` check (:988-992) above the processing branch (:984-987). The processing branch then only applies to a first capture, unchanged: it closes the sheet and the capture is processed and kept in the pending list.

2. Add a field `int _returns = 0;` next to `_previousResult` (:351), with a one-line comment: `Counts going back to the previous result, so an understanding step already running knows its words were cancelled.` In `_backToResult`, when `_phase == _CapturePhase.processing`, restore at once: don't await `_starting`, `_finishRecording` or `_writes`, and don't discard `_session` there (the running `_process` owns it, step 3). Do `_returns++`, `_words.clear()`, `ref.invalidate(pendingCapturesProvider)` and the same `setState` as :1053-1061 plus `_phase = _CapturePhase.idle`. In the existing listening path, also do `_returns++` just before its `setState`.

3. In `_process`, at its start, record `final returns = _returns;` and `final replacing = _previousResult;`, and use a local `bool wentBack() => replacing != null && _returns != returns;`. Check it (a) after `await _writes` (:891): if it went back, return before `_ensureSession`, so the restored previous session is never updated with the new words; (b) right after `_ensureSession` (:895), keep `final attempt = _session;` and check again; (c) after `CaptureProcessor(_store, api).process(...)` returns (:897): if it went back, don't assign `_session`, don't call `_review`, and discard the new capture instead. (d) In the `catch`: if it went back, discard the new capture quietly and don't call `_showProblem`. To discard: when `attempt != null && attempt.id != replacing!.id`, `await _store.discard(attempt.id, _owner)` in a try/catch, then `_container?.invalidate(pendingCapturesProvider)`, as `_dropPrevious` does (it works after the sheet closes). The `finally` stays as it is: the phase is already idle after going back.
4. The result that comes back keeps its edits (it is the same `_previousResult` object P60 stored after awaiting CaptureResult's `_writes`), and Cancelar on it then closes the sheet as on any result.

UX-462 (S1; R2A-3, verified in code). App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:264-268, `_dateLine`: `excludeSemantics: true` drops the ListTile's own enabled state, so while saving (`widget.enabled == false`) the node is a button with no tap action and TalkBack doesn't say it's disabled. Add `enabled: widget.enabled,` to that `Semantics` (keep `button: true`, the label and `onTap: widget.enabled ? _schedule : null`). It covers both the main and the collapsed line, since both use this method. No visible change.
No new strings and no ARB changes. Tests: keep the existing ones passing (capture_result_exits_test.dart holds P60's); ux-tester writes the acceptance tests.

Don't touch: the listening state's layout and controls, `_discard` and the keep/discard dialog for a first capture, `_exits`, the result's content, the save logic, P37's landing, home_screen.dart (U5 is escalated).
acceptance: Widget test (Spanish, a spoken result, a capture processor that waits until the test releases it): change the title to `Comprar pan integral`, tap `Volver a decirlo`, give new words, tap `Listo`, and while `Entendiendo…` shows tap `Cancelar`. The previous result shows at once with `Comprar pan integral` and no `captureKeepQuestion` dialog appears. Release the processor and settle: the result still shows `Comprar pan integral`, no error shows, and the pending list holds exactly one capture, the original.
Widget test: the same flow, using the system Back instead of `Cancelar` while `Entendiendo…` shows: same outcome, the sheet stays open with the previous result and one capture is pending.
Widget test: the same flow, but the held processing fails after Cancelar: the previous result shows with no error message, and one capture is pending.
Widget test: a first capture (no `Volver a decirlo`): `Cancelar` while `Entendiendo…` shows closes the sheet, and after processing finishes the capture is in the pending list (unchanged behaviour).
Widget test: `Volver a decirlo`, new words, `Listo`, and processing completes with no cancel: the new result shows and the pending list holds one capture, the new one (P60's test still passes).

Semantics test (Spanish, a result dated today): while saving, the date line's node reads `Fecha y hora: Hoy`, has an enabled state that is false and no tap action; when not saving, it is enabled and has a tap action that opens the date sheet.
deviceChecks: Phone, Spanish: on a spoken result, `Volver a decirlo`, say new words, `Listo`, then Back during `Entendiendo…`: the previous result returns, and Pendientes shows one capture after a moment.
TalkBack, Spanish: tap `Añadir…` and move focus to the date line while saving: TalkBack says it is disabled.

packages.title: Moving: Sin fecha closes the sheet even with an empty hour
brief: Context: P61 (b3 round 2) was verified: UX-452, UX-453, UX-454 and UX-455 are fixed. Keep the move sheet's day chips applying at once (:235-243), Listo's drop-the-keyboard-and-scroll for a missing a. m./p. m. (`_done`, :122-139), the live-region error, the new help line and the repeat sheet's `Listo`. This is one regression of P61, first attempt.

UX-463 (S1; R2B-1, verified in code). In the move sheet (`Cambiar fecha`), with `Añadir hora` on and the hour empty or invalid, tapping `Sin fecha` calls `_select(null)` and then `_done()`. `_select` sets `_hasTime = false` at once, but the hour field is still in the form until the next frame, so `_done()`'s `_form.currentState!.validate()` (App/lib/widgets/schedule_editor.dart:121) fails on the empty hour and the sheet stays open. The rebuild then removes the time row and its error, so the person sees no reason. A second tap works.

Fix: in `_done`, change `final valid = _form.currentState!.validate();` to `final valid = !_hasTime || _form.currentState!.validate();`. With no time there is nothing in the form to check. `_hasTime` is already false at that point, because a `setState` callback runs before it returns. This also covers Listo with the time turned off.

No new strings. Don't touch: the `_missingDate` check above it, the `missingPeriod` logic and its scroll, `_select`, the chips, TaskEditor's and the capture result's select-only chips, task_interactions.dart.
acceptance: Widget test (Spanish, 390×844): open the move sheet (`Cambiar fecha`) of a dated task with no time, turn on `Añadir hora` and leave the hour empty, then tap `Sin fecha` once. The sheet closes, `Movida a la bandeja de entrada` shows, and the task has no date.
Widget test: the same sheet with `Añadir hora` on and the hour empty, tap `Hoy`: the sheet stays open and the hour field shows its error (unchanged).

decisions.question: U5 (escalated, with UX-460): may the loop make a third attempt at landing the new task on Tareas when animations are off? Two attempts failed: P37 (b3 round 1) called showOnScreen inside the NestedScrollView, which moved nothing; P59 (b3 round 2) measures the row on screen and moves the header then the list, which works with animations on, at 2x text and when the row already shows, but with animations off leaves the row 47 of its 123 px under the `Añadida…` message.
decisions.recommendation: Approve one more, narrow attempt in App/lib/screens/home_screen.dart only: base the clearance on the message's final place, visible.bottom minus the SnackBar box's size.height minus 8 (its height is already final while it slides in), and if the message isn't laid out yet, make the single correction after the snackbar's entry finishes rather than after one frame. Keep one correction at most. The acceptance is the existing failing test `U5: with animations off…` in App/test/capture_landing_test.dart, unchanged. This is a technical fix, not a product change; it is escalated only because the rule stops a third automatic try. Until then, the round check keeps failing on that one test, and UX_REVIEW §7 task 2 stays a phone check.

escalated.tried: Round 1 (P37, b3): the Tareas `_reveal` called `row.showOnScreen` inside the NestedScrollView; the inner viewport counted the row as visible, so nothing moved (row y 676-799, list ends at 650; capture_landing_test failed at hitTestable). Round 2 (P59, b3): `_reveal` / `_shortfall` / `_scrollBy` (home_screen.dart:136-245) measure the row against the NestedScrollView's on-screen rect, move the outer controller then the inner one, correct once after endOfFrame, keep the build-out loop, and jump when animations are off. Passes: the main Tareas test, 2x text at 360x740, no movement when the row already shows, Calendar landing. Fails with animations off (390x844, Spanish, 14 tasks, Prioridad alta): row 427-550, message top 503, list area 64-650. Likely cause (inferred): the jump and its one correction run before the SnackBar settles, so `_messageTop` (:181-200) reads a provisional top or falls back to the 88 px clearance, while the message is 147 px tall. Failing test: capture_landing_test.dart 'U5: with animations off…'. Calendar, the two-day batch and the pending list landings are verified.

Regression R2A-1 from P59 (b3 round 2): the animations-off part of U5 above, under its own ID. Not re-planned, because it is the part of U5 that has now failed twice. The reviewer's proposed fix is in the U5 decision.
